name: Angel
entriesHtml: This flawless alabaster mask depicts a serene Celestial. Once per turn when you deal damage to a creature with an attack or spell, you can expend a use of your Bardic Inspiration|Bard|XPHB|1 to deal extra Radiant damage to the target equal to one roll of your Bardic Inspiration|Bard|XPHB|1 die.

name: Archmage
entriesHtml:
This clay mask topped with a pointed hat bears the wrinkles of a cantankerous archmage. When you reach a Bard level specified in the following table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared while you wear this mask.

Bard LevelSpells
3Fire Bolt, Scorching Ray, Thunderwave
5Lightning Bolt
7Ice Storm
9Wall of Stone
description: This clay mask topped with a pointed hat bears the wrinkles of a cantankerous archmage. When you reach a Bard level specified in the following table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared while you wear this mask.

name: Devil
entriesHtml: This obsidian mask bears the fangs and horns of a handsome fiend. When you take damage from a creature that is within 30 feet of yourself, you can expend a use of your Bardic Inspiration|Bard|XPHB|1 as a Reaction|XPHB to deal Fire damage to the creature. This damage equals two rolls of your Bardic Inspiration|Bard|XPHB|1 die, and you gain Temporary Hit Points|XPHB equal to the damage dealt.

name: Dragon
entriesHtml: When you put on this mask, and as a Bonus Action|XPHB on each of your turns while you wear it, you can expend a Bardic Inspiration|Bard|XPHB|1 die to exhale flames in a 15-foot Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone. Each creature in the Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone makes a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, a creature takes Fire damage equal to two rolls of your Bardic Inspiration|Bard|XPHB|1 die, or half as much damage on a successful save.

name: Faceless
entriesHtml: Two perfectly round eyeholes stare out of this otherwise featureless porcelain mask. While you wear this mask, you always have the Disguise Self spell prepared. Whenever you start casting the spell, you can modify it so that it doesn't require a spell slot. If you do so, the spell's casting time becomes 1 minute for that casting and its duration becomes 8 hours. The spell ends early if you remove this mask.

name: Gladiator
entriesHtml: This grim metal helm, pockmarked and scratched, conceals the entire face. While you wear this mask, you have proficiency with Martial weapons and training with Shield. As a Bonus Action|XPHB, you can expend a use of your Bardic Inspiration|Bard|XPHB|1 to make one attack with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike|XPHB.

name: Hierophant
entriesHtml:
In lieu of a face, this bronze mask bears the image of a holy symbol, with the barest of slits to see through. When you reach a Bard level specified in the following table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared while you wear this mask.

Bard LevelSpells
3Aid, Cure Wounds, Spare the Dying
5Revivify
7Death Ward
9Mass Cure Wounds

name: Jester
entriesHtml: This cloth mask of a grinning jester is adorned with bells and checkerboard patterns. When you put on this mask, and as a Bonus Action|XPHB on each of your turns while you wear it, you can move up to half your Speed|XPHB without provoking Opportunity Attack. You can also expend a use of Bardic Inspiration|Bard|XPHB|1 to cast Vicious Mockery as a part of this mask's Bonus Action|XPHB.

name: Noble
entriesHtml: This gleaming silver mask has two rubies set into its eyesockets. You can use your Bardic Inspiration|Bard|XPHB|1 as a part of the Bonus Action|XPHB to put on this mask. When a creature with your Bardic Inspiration|Bard|XPHB|1 die fails a D20 Test|XPHB while you wear this mask, it can roll the Bardic Inspiration|Bard|XPHB|1 die twice and add the higher result to the d20.
